content.title: American Air Took 'Substantial' Hit From Shutdown, CEO Says
content.description: American Airlines Group Inc. CEO Robert Isom says the carrier took a "substantial" hit from the recent government shutdown. But he says the airline has bounced back and he's pleased with holiday bookings. He speaks to Bloomberg's Lisa Abramowicz.

content.title: ‘All Airlines Are Poised to Bounce’: Citi Makes the Case for Buying These 2 Airline Stocks Now
content.summary: The airline industry struggled over the past year, with multiple headwinds weighing on demand. Looking ahead to 2026, however, Citi analyst John Godyn sees conditions improving and expects a broad recovery across the sector. Still, not all airlines are positioned equally.
